name: mutation-db-decoupling
body: The structural decoupling of the durable mutation path from the DB (fix-ladder option c): validate structural references (edge endpoints, constraint `attaches-to`, contains/depends-on acyclicity, pairing) from the node files alone, and resolve code-FQN `implemented-by` refs from `apg/.trans/graph.jsonl` via `apg.artifacts.code_universes_from_export` (real code FQNs ∪ the plan store's planned FQNs) instead of opening `db.lbug` read-write. Validation opens no DB, and `apg.git.reanchor_scan_meta` is graph.jsonl-only; the one remaining DB access on the direct path is the post-commit projection apply (`apg.artifacts.reingest_layers`), which runs inside the extended flock and so provably does not contend — satisfying the requirement's "no exclusive open, or no contention" acceptance. The session path amortizes that single open through the coordinator's held handle. `apg.artifacts.code_universes` still exists, but its remaining callers are the flock-guarded plan paths; it is no longer on the node/edge mutation path. This removes DB contention ONLY: it is a complement, never the race fix — the node-file read-modify-write and the git index commit still race — so serialization is delivered elsewhere, by the extended file-level flock over the whole durable sequence on the transparent direct path (evaluate-fix-ladder option a) and by the single-writer session coordinator while a session is live (option d). This component may not be read as satisfying `concurrent-bursts-reliable` on its own. `apg.layers.write_project` (with `write_project_with`) is the orchestrator; a missing/stale DB is tolerated, and the next scan rebuilds the projection.
